title: protoforge.yaml
description: Configuration for protoforge: Drizzle -> TypeSpec -> OpenAPI -> .proto. See docs/config.md.

env_file.description: dotenv file loaded into every child process (and used for DATABASE_URL). Does not override variables already set. A missing file is ignored.

env.description: Extra environment variables for child processes. Values support ${VAR} expansion and override the environment.

node_runner.description: Package-manager exec command used as the last fallback for npm tools. Default: picked from the nearest lockfile (pnpm exec | bunx | yarn exec | npx).

openapi_generator.description: Command for openapi-generator. Default: openapi-generator-cli on PATH.

drizzle_kit.description: Command for drizzle-kit. Default: node_modules/.bin, then PATH, then the node runner.

drizzle_docs.description: Command for drizzle-docs. Default: node_modules/.bin, then PATH, then the node runner.

tsp.description: Command for the TypeSpec compiler. Default: node_modules/.bin, then PATH, then the node runner.

openapi_format.description: Command for openapi-format. Default: node_modules/.bin, then PATH, then the node runner.

ts_runner.description: Runs the embedded Drizzle -> TypeSpec script. Default: tsx, then bun, then node --experimental-strip-types (Node >= 22.6).

tools.description: Overrides for how external tools are invoked. All optional; auto-detected.

drizzle_config.description: Passed to drizzle-kit as --config (relative to dir).

drizzle_out.description: Drizzle's out directory, read by sync (relative to dir).

docs.description: Run drizzle-docs generate. Use docs: {} for all defaults; omit to skip.

post_push_sql.description: Raw SQL run in ONE transaction over DATABASE_URL after push (rolled back on error). Each entry may hold several statements or DO blocks. Also runnable with --only post_push_sql.

to.description: Target directory (relative to migration.dir). Its contents are replaced; must be inside the repo root.

suffix.description: Suffix appended to each migration directory name.

extra_replace.description: Extra rewrite rules applied to each written file.

sync.description: Copy drizzle/<name>/migration.sql to <to>/<name><suffix>, turning backticks into double quotes and removing statement-breakpoint lines. Omit to skip.

run_after.description: Escape-hatch commands run in dir after the stage.

migration.description: Drizzle stage: drizzle-kit generate/push/migrate, drizzle-docs, post_push_sql and sync. Absent = stage disabled; empty = enabled with defaults.

entry.description: Entry passed to tsp compile (relative to dir). Without dir/tspconfig.yaml a built-in config is used.

schema_dir.description: Directory of Drizzle *.ts schema files (relative to typespec.dir).

namespace.description: TypeSpec namespace of the generated file.

require_docs.description: Columns without a // doc comment: warn prints a warning, error fails without writing, off is silent.

from_drizzle.description: Generate TypeSpec models/enums from the Drizzle schema with the embedded script. Omit to skip.

run_after.description: Escape-hatch commands run in dir after the stage.

typespec.description: TypeSpec stage: embedded Drizzle -> TypeSpec generator and tsp compile. Absent = stage disabled; empty = enabled with defaults.

format.description: Run openapi-format with dir/oaf-config.yaml (or a built-in config).

go_tags.description: Inject x-oapi-codegen-extra-tags (validate / jsonschema Go struct tags).

lint.description: Spectral ruleset path; used only by stage openapi --only lint.

run_after.description: Escape-hatch commands run in dir after the stage.

openapi.description: OpenAPI stage: openapi-format and Go struct-tag injection. Absent = stage disabled; empty = enabled with defaults.

templates.description: Directory with api.mustache / model.mustache (relative to dir). Default: the embedded templates.

proto_package.description: Version segment: package models.<v> / services.<v>, output dirs registry/{models,services}/<v>.

well_known.description: OpenAPI type -> protobuf type, passed as --type-mappings with matching --import-mappings.

any_type.description: Replacement for the generator's AnyType (and its any_type.proto import).

drop_imports.description: Import stems (prefix match) whose import lines are removed, e.g. todo_object_mapping.

flatten_requests.description: Inline model fields into *Request service messages.

extra_replace.description: Rewrite rules applied to registry/{models,services}/<v> after flattening.

enabled.description: Run the commands at the end of the proto stage.

codegen.description: Optional minimal codegen step run in dir (e.g. buf generate).

run_after.description: Escape-hatch commands run in dir after the stage.

proto.description: Proto stage: openapi-generator protobuf-schema passes, normalisation and request flattening. Absent = stage disabled; empty = enabled with defaults.

pipelines.description: Named sequences of stages, single steps (stage.step, e.g. typespec.from_drizzle) and/or other pipelines. Defaults: api = [typespec, openapi, proto], sql = [migration], all = [sql, api], preview = [migration.docs, typespec, openapi] (no DB writes), proto-gen = api without proto codegen (no DB writes).

command.description: A command: a plain string (split into argv, run without a shell) or {cmd, shell}.

cmd.description: Command line. Split into argv shell-style and run without a shell unless shell is true.

shell.description: Run through sh -c (cmd /C on Windows). Escape hatch only.

glob.description: Files the rule applies to. Without a slash it matches the base name (e.g. *.proto); with a slash, the path relative to the rule's base dir.

regex.description: Go RE2 regex applied to the whole file; 'to' may use $1 / ${name}. Use (?m) for per-line ^ and $.

delete_line_matching.description: Go RE2 regex; every matching line is deleted.
